title: Auf dem Gipfel
desc: Everybody says du up here, and nobody does down there
setting: Two thousand metres, twenty people, and a white blanket over the whole lake below.

options.feedback: Hoi back, and du, because you are on a mountain. Down in the town this would be Grüezi and Sie.
Not wrong and a step more formal than what she just gave you. Up here that reads as a little stiff.
On a summit, with a rucksack, at eleven in the morning. Nobody says that here.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.en: Did you come up on foot?

options.feedback: True, and there is no shame in it. She walked four hours and will not say a word about the difference.
Better still. It answers and it says something about you at the same time.
Your shoes say otherwise. She looked at them before she asked.

steps.speaker: Selina
steps.es: Ich bin um halb sechs losgegangen.
steps.en: I set off at half past five.

options.feedback: Ask back. She got out of the fog into the sun at about seven and she would like somebody to hear it.
Fair reaction. It is also completely normal here, and she will say so.

options.es: Das ist zu früh für mich.
options.en: That is too early for me.
options.feedback: Honest, and it turns her morning into a fact about you.
The true answer, and she will nod and not ask again. Nobody else has asked you this at all.
Bigger than you know. She asked the one question everybody here avoids, so she will hear the size of it.
Because she wanted to know. It is the first real question anybody has put to you in nine months.
